payments.title: Payments
payments.partial: The node has more than {count} entries here. It lists its oldest first, so only the oldest {count} are loaded and the newest are missing. Read more to load them.
payments.emptySentHelp: Payments this node makes, from this app or any other, appear here. Use Pay to send one.
payments.emptyReceivedHelp: Invoices of this node, from this app or any other, appear here. Use Receive to create one.
payments.noPayment: This node has no payment with this hash. If you have just paid, the node may not have recorded it yet: check again in a moment.
payments.pendingHelp: The node is still trying this payment. This page updates when the node reports the result.
payments.label: Label
payments.noPreimage: The proof of payment (preimage) is shown only on the pay screen right after paying.
payments.noInvoice: This node has no invoice with this hash.
payments.waiting: Waiting for payment. This page updates by itself when the invoice is paid.
